notes.title: Rebirth of Darkness: From 'Olho Adventure' to 'Moli's Descent
notes.content:
Get ready for a total makeover with the massive update to “Olho Adventure.” Now featuring the new protagonist, Moli, you’ll be immersed in a dark world filled with deep mysteries. Every aspect of the original game has been reimagined—from the features to the story—creating a whole new experience.

Armed with her sword and courage, Moli explores an underground cavern full of secrets. Face new enemies, discover hidden passages, and unravel the mysteries that define the heroine’s fate. This update is not just a sequel; it’s a reimagining that takes the gameplay, storyline, and atmosphere to new heights.

Embark on this journey of rebirth and discover what the darkness has in store for you. The choices you make will determine Moli’s future in a world where every detail has been meticulously recreated to deliver an unforgettable adventure.

notes.title: Cooperative Mode
notes.content:
-Several small bugs have been fixed
Now you can play co-op with your friend

Using the joystick, press any button for the first time by default the second player will start with 1 desert warrior, if he comes to die or pressing L2 he will stay in spirit mode until he touches an enemy or boss, after he touches he clones himself in the creature.

Remembering that this is still in beta, and not all creatures are yet that he can transform.

The game's default camera is only focused on the first player, if the second player leaves the field of view, he is teleported to the first player's location, depending on the feedback, the camera may change, unfortunately the pixel game maker engine does not allow a separate screen, but I can work so that the camera expands always showing the two players, but I still don't know which option to choose so please give me the feedback.

UPDATE OF 03/22/23
Update
Additional and changes
(No more spam)
After you get the firepower the game ends up getting very embarrassed, it really is a very strong skill, to balance I implemented a new mana bar, which encompasses firepower, ice and also the charged maximum shot, with each use of these skills spent -1 of mana.

The damage charged maximum = the value of your new mana bar.

Now some maps are connected, yes, now you can go from map 1 to map 2.

when you have power 5 (Crow) now you can run faster, this passive is turned off if you don't have crow mana.
